event_format: CI supplies the actual PR title and writes its body to a file
commit_range: base..head, including every commit; base=root denotes the initial one-commit push
valid_body: Two plain sentences about the change.
long_body_control: A paragraph repeated across 140 lines must be refused.
metadata_policy: No private citations, personal paths or development-process labels, even beside a test name.
file_policy: Apply the publication scanner to files and decoded container members.
result: 0 accepts; nonzero refuses with a content diagnostic, never a traceback or usage error
